text: On an isolated farm in upstate New York, the Abbott family lives in near silence, walking on sand paths and speaking in sign language, because [blind creatures with acute hearing|threat|monsters and creatures] [kill anything that makes a sound|rules|how it hunts]. Their youngest son was taken after switching on a noisy toy, and their deaf daughter Regan [carries the guilt in silence|wrong|an accident and its guilt]. Now Evelyn is pregnant, and the day her labour begins, she steps on a nail on the basement stairs.
